character: vain glossy dark-brown mink, sleek shiny fur, smug, always in motion
props: wooden picket fence across a snowy yard, intact all clip; weasel neighbour at the pickets close to the lens beyond it, thin dull fur, red scarf
motion_rule: mink crosses into a new spot every window, never speaks from one place; camera and shot size change every window, never the same size twice running; the weasel does a new gag every window, large and close to the lens
environment: snowy backyard, bright sunny midday, hard shadows, wooden picket fence

audio.delivery: smug self-satisfied female voice, native Russian stress, calm
audio.pronunciation: stress: shi-KAR-ny, se-BYA, GLAV-no-ye, sa-SYE-di, za-VEE-do-va-li — the stressed syllable in the last word is VEE, never ZA-vi-do-va-li
audio.pacing: even natural pacing, lines fit their windows with room to spare
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: snow crunch, fence creaks under the weasel, envious squeaks

timeline.a: mink bursts from a snowbank in a blast of snow to yard centre | weasel's head pops over the pickets, cracks his chin
mink strides left along the fence, back arching in a wave | weasel rips the red scarf off his neck and flings it into the snow
mink tumbles over a snowbank into the pickets | weasel climbs a picket, licking his thin fur flat to shine
mink runs a half circle to yard centre, tail whipping | weasel rubs snow into his fur and turns into a wet lump
mink shakes off snow in a wide fan, steps to the fence | the fan buries the weasel, only his eyes showing
mink glides along the pickets right to left, fur brushing their tops | weasel gnaws a picket, spits splinters
mink sprints, leaps a snowbank, fur fanning mid-air, lands by the pickets | weasel grips a picket, one eye twitching
weasel raises a claw, jabs his own left eye and presses a paw over it, aiming the other at her | mink dashes past, flicking snow at him
weasel digs the scarf from the snow and ties it over that eye like a pirate patch, squinting with the one left | mink rolls off a snowdrift across the snow
weasel points at her two eyes and holds up two claws, grinning under the patch | mink skids low through the snow to the fence
weasel misjudges with one eye and headbutts a picket, sliding down it | mink bounds a snowbank, lands spinning at yard centre
weasel climbs the pickets again, patch askew, paw stretching after her | mink races along the fence to the lens, snow spraying
mink sweeps to the pickets and swings her flared fur across the lens | weasel beside her, one-eyed under the red patch, beaming with envy

must_appear: fence intact in every frame; weasel close to it with a new gag every window; he jabs his own eye at 6.3 and wears the scarf as a patch to the end; both in frame at 9.3-10.0
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, dusk, evening, dim, moody, low key, neon, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, static camera, locked-off shots, same shot size twice, only her head moving, speaking from one spot, a window where the weasel does nothing, the fence breaking, a picket torn loose, blood, gore, wound, the weasel touching the mink, floating objects, duplicate props, extra limbs, more than two characters, character changing mid-shot, English speech, foreign accent, Latin letters, any word after 6.3
